notes.title: Update v1.13
notes.notes:
[h2]Isle Of Jura Version 1.13[/h2]

[list]
[*] Reduced duration of fish display animation
[*] Reduced overall fly fishing difficulty
[*] Fixed being able to fish in rivers with the incorrect rod type
[*] Made adjustments to island geometry and player hitbox to prevent players getting stuck
[*] Added autosaving when the player catches a fish
[*] Added an "unstuck" button in the options menu (use this if you get yourself trapped)
[*] Fixed various bugs that occurred when the player has a full inventory
[*] Fixed NPCs sometimes remaining in their talk animation after dialogue has finished
[/list]

notes.title: New update coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

First off, thanks to all the new players we've had after the free weekend. It's great to see your feedback and bug reports in the steam discussions!

Due to full time work, I haven't been able to work on the game. Now that I have more free time, I'm working on a new update to fix existing bugs and add some user experience improvements.

For any bugs you encounter, or any suggestions you have for the game, please send details of these to emgamesdev@gmail.com - i'll be sure to read through them all and do what I can.

Trading cards / badges / profile backgrounds will also be here soon, pending approval from Steam.

Thanks again for playing!

E.

We are excited to share that the Isle of Jura game will be released this Friday, Feb. 11th! We can't wait to see what you all catch in Isle of Jura. We've just uploaded a new build with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1703140/view/3130567756993437861]bug fixes and QOL updates.[/url]

[h2]About the Game[/h2]

Alex needs to finish her biology report! Looking for species to study, she's taking a fishing trip to Jura, a remote and beautiful island.

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Catch over 50 species of fish
[*] Master 3 different fishing techniques
[*] Find artifacts and complete the island collection
[*] Chat with the island residents
[*] Explore at your own pace
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1703140/Isle_of_Jura/
